title: Furg Citadel

buildingCutout.basis: Bounded to the separately mapped castle enclosure. Forg village lies outside this footprint.

terrainReference.basis: Source elevation beside the documented lower east gate, at the midpoint of the mapped eastern curtain.

identities.name: Furg Citadel
identities.address: Forg village, Darmian County, South Khorasan, Iran

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped ridge enclosure controls overall width, bend order and position. Independent terrain gives the east-to-west rise. The public-domain village view controls the recognizable south curtain and western compound profile.

note: The official visitor inventory identifies the low east gate, middle zone and highest western compound, with rounded earthen masonry towers and successive repairs. Proportions of individual towers and incomplete masonry are estimated against the mapped width and the cleared ground view.
